name: CursedForge
summary:
CursedForge is a co-op crafting and survival game for Meta Quest. It is in development. **Add it to your wishlist**, and the Store tells you when you can play.

### Hold your tools
Hold a pick in your hand and hit the rock to get the ore. Tools wear when you use them, and they can break. Keep a spare in your backpack.
